title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Phenotypic Characterisation in Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
abstract: arXiv:2609.14418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling requires decisions to be made under precedence constraints, limited resources, multiple execution modes, and uncertain activity durations. Genetic programming (GP) can automatically evolve heuristic rules for such problems, but its simulation-based fitness evaluation is computationally expensive. This study investigates phenotypic characterisation (PC) in surrogate-assisted GP to evolve higher-quality scheduling heuristics under a fixed budget of full simulation-based fitness evaluations. A key question is how GP individuals should be encoded into phenotypic characterisations to support effective fitness estimation. translated_title: 动态多模式项目调度中基于表型特征化的代理辅助遗传规划
translated_abstract: 动态多模式资源受限项目调度需要在优先约束、资源有限、多种执行模式以及活动工期不确定的条件下做出决策。遗传规划（GP）可以为这类问题自动演化启发式规则，但其基于仿真的适应度评估计算代价高昂。本研究在代理辅助遗传规划中研究了表型特征化（PC）方法，以便在固定的完整仿真适应度评估预算下演化出更高质量的调度启发式规则。一个关键问题是如何将遗传规划的个体编码为表型特征化，以支持有效的适应度估计。为了回答这一问题，本研究设计了三种具有不同信息丰富程度的PC编码方案：优先值编码，用于保留规则的原始输出；排序编码，用于捕捉候选者的排序信息；以及二进制编码，用于表示最终的选择决策。
tldr: 本研究将表型特征化引入代理辅助遗传规划，通过设计优先值编码、排序编码和二进制编码三种不同信息丰富度的编码方案来有效估计适应度，从而在固定的仿真评估预算下为动态多模式资源受限项目调度演化出更高质量的启发式规则。
en_tdlr: This study introduces phenotypic characterisation into surrogate-assisted genetic programming, designing three encoding schemes of varying information richness (priority-value, rank, and binary encoding) to enable effective fitness estimation, thereby evolving higher-quality heuristics for dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling under a fixed budget of simulation-based evaluations.
